title: Veldrin Tidal Array
text: The Veldrin Tidal Array was commissioned in 2019 in the strait off Port Hask. It consists of 48 seabed turbines with a combined capacity of 62 megawatts and is operated by Norvane Energy. Construction cost 310 million crowns, about a fifth over the original budget, mainly because of delays laying the export cable. In a typical year the array supplies electricity for roughly 41,000 homes. Norvane has said the turbines are expected to run for 25 years before major refurbishment.

facts.fact: It is operated by Norvane Energy

title: Lumen Sync protocol, version 3
text: Version 3 of the Lumen Sync protocol was released in March 2022. Its main change is a shorter handshake: a connection is now established in 2 round trips instead of 4. The maximum packet size was fixed at 1,380 bytes to avoid fragmentation on common tunnels. The protocol was designed by Ilse Marrow and her group at Kettering Labs, who published the specification under an open licence. Version 2 endpoints remain compatible, but they cannot use the shorter handshake.

title: Bark beetle infestation in Brannoch Forest
text: A 2021 study led by Dr. Oren Halvik surveyed 214 plots across Brannoch Forest. The team found that bark beetle infestation rose by 37 percent after two consecutive dry summers. Stands dominated by a single spruce species were hit hardest, while mixed stands showed little change. The results were published in the Journal of Boreal Ecology. Halvik cautioned that the survey covered only three years and could not separate drought from the effect of earlier storm damage.

facts.fact: The study was led by Oren Halvik

title: Quillon Robotics company profile
text: Quillon Robotics was founded in 2014 in the city of Tarrow and now employs 1,250 people. Its revenue in 2023 was 480 million crowns. The company is led by chief executive Mara Dent, who joined from a logistics firm in 2018. Its best-selling product is the Strider K4, a warehouse robot that can lift 35 kilograms and run for a full shift on one charge. Most of Quillon's customers are grocery distributors.

title: Zentravir phase 3 trial
text: The phase 3 trial of the antiviral Zentravir enrolled 2,840 participants. Compared with placebo, the drug reduced hospitalisation by 58 percent when treatment began within three days of symptoms. The most common side effect was headache, reported by 12 percent of those treated. The Meridian Health Agency approved Zentravir in August 2023 for adults at high risk. The trial did not include children or pregnant women, so its results do not extend to those groups.

title: Lake Arvenne
text: Lake Arvenne has a surface area of 87 square kilometres and reaches 312 metres at its deepest point. It is fed mainly by the River Solde, which enters at the northern end. The lake freezes over for an average of 41 days each winter, a figure that has fallen over the past half century. It is the only known habitat of the silverfin char, a fish found nowhere else. Fishing for the char has been banned since a population survey found numbers falling.

title: Halden Bridge
text: Halden Bridge opened to traffic in 1987. It is a cable-stayed bridge with a main span of 940 metres, designed by the engineer Petra Voss. A retrofit completed in 2016 replaced the deck bearings and cost 74 million crowns. The bridge now carries about 58,000 vehicles a day, well above the volume it was planned for. A second crossing has been proposed several times but has never been funded.

title: Astrel Corvid-9 processor
text: Astrel Semiconductors released the Corvid-9 processor in November 2024. It is built on a 3 nanometre process, has 24 cores, and is rated at 95 watts. Astrel reports that it is 18 percent faster than its predecessor, the Corvid-8, on its own benchmark suite. Independent reviewers have not yet confirmed that figure. The chip uses the same socket as the Corvid-8, so existing boards can be upgraded.

facts.fact: Reported 18 percent faster than the Corvid-8
